effects.effect: Before the [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) is resolved, you [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) the target to a square [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to you and opposite the one they started in. If the target can't be [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport)ed this way, you can't [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) them.

metadata.content:
*You step momentarily out of phase as you pull an enemy through you.*

| **[Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee), Psionic, [Strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), Weapon** |               **[Main action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) 1**                     | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility):**

- **≤11:** 4 + A damage; [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 2
- **12-16:** 6 + A damage; [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 4
- **17+:** 8 + A damage; [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 6

**Effect:** Before the [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) is resolved, you [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) the target to a square [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to you and opposite the one they started in. If the target can't be [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport)ed this way, you can't [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) them.
